about_the_game:
This Season Pass includes 3 paid DLCs for the upcoming "Dream Sketcher" project.

DLC01 (Tentative title): Adding script, investigator, and card expansion. The script includes a brand new gameplay mechanism, a new style of story, and can be played by multiple players. Expected to be released in the late summer of 2023.
DLC02 (Tentative Title): Adding 1 script, 1 investigator, and a card expansion. The script includes a brand new gameplay mechanism, continuation of the main storyline, and is multiplayer compatible. Expected release date is third quarter of 2023.
DLC03 (Tentative name): Adding a brand new game mode, 1 investigator, and card expansion. The new game mode combines Rouge with cooperative and competitive features, allowing players to explore Eric's insane dreamscape layer by layer alone or in teams, while constantly accumulating their own card and skill resources. Each dream layer will have randomly generated gameplay with different themes. Expected to be released in the third quarter of 2023.

By purchasing this bundle, you can get a more favorable price for the "Dream Sketcher" game and the above DLCs. When these DLCs are released in the future, you can play them directly without having to purchase them again.
Please note: According to the actual development situation, the release time of the above DLCs may be subject to certain changes.
